# Libraries and data

## Libraries

```{r}
library(conflicted)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(tidyr)
library(worrms)
```

```{r}
#| warning: true

conflicted::conflict_scout()
```

```{r}
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter())
```

## Data

```{r}
zooplankton_data <- read.csv(here("Data/Temp/zoo_clean.csv"))
phytoplankton_data <- read.csv(here("Data/Temp/phyto_clean.csv"))
```

# Processing

## Preparation

Make classification tables from AphiaID values.

```{r}
id_to_taxo <- data.frame(
  taxo_id = c(
    unique(zooplankton_data$taxo_id),
    unique(phytoplankton_data$taxo_id)
  )
)
```

Remove rows where id = 1 ("Biota", brings no information on what this organism is)

```{r}
id_to_taxo <- id_to_taxo |>
  filter(taxo_id != 1)
```

```{r}
head(id_to_taxo)
```

## Scraping

Scrape WORMS (https://www.marinespecies.org/) to get the taxonomic information corresponding to each AphiaID

```{r}
get_taxo_from_id <- function(taxo_id) {
  wm_classification(taxo_id) |>
    select(-AphiaID) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = rank, values_from = scientificname)
}
```

```{r}
id_to_taxo <- cbind(
  id_to_taxo,
  bind_rows(lapply(id_to_taxo$taxo_id, get_taxo_from_id))
)
```

```{r}
head(id_to_taxo)
```

Select the 7 commonly used levels of phylogeny : Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus and Species.

```{r}
id_to_taxo <- id_to_taxo |>
  select(taxo_id, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species)
```

```{r}
head(id_to_taxo)
```

# Exporting

Join the taxonomic information of each id to the original plankton dataframes

```{r}
zooplankton_data <- zooplankton_data |>
  left_join(id_to_taxo)

phytoplankton_data <- phytoplankton_data |>
  left_join(id_to_taxo)
```

```{r}
head(zooplankton_data)
```

```{r}
write.csv(
  zooplankton_data,
  here("Data/Temp/zoo_with_taxo.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  phytoplankton_data,
  here("Data/Temp/phyto_with_taxo.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
